title: Eddington: physics is a schedule of pointer readings

statements.text: Science has nothing to say about the intrinsic nature of the atom. The atom of physics, like everything else in physics, is a schedule of pointer readings, which exact science studies and connects with other pointer readings, attached to an unknown background.

sources.quote: But now we realise that science has nothing to say as to the intrinsic nature of the atom.
The physical atom is, like everything else in physics, a schedule of pointer readings.
a set of pointer readings, which exact science can study and connect with other pointer readings
